summary: An agent card says down, and since when, for a declared seat with no session, and a long working turn stays working

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; the new state is computed from existing claims at read time.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The client contract gains the AgentState value `down` and two optional fields: `down_since` on the agent card and `holder_down_since` on its work labels; the contract hash changes with them.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Additive client contract. AgentState is an open enum and the new card fields are optional, so an older stui, phone app or web app receives an unknown state string and keeps its own label (starting or unknown); it does not fail to decode. Behavior change on the status contract: a stale `working` harness report is no longer rewritten to `indeterminate` after 90 seconds, and a fresh harness report makes a seat running even when its runtime row is still pending.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart; no additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
